entries.text:
The smell of the forest after rain.
The cool breeze against my skin.
The sound of birdsong in the early morning.

A fresh apple, picked straight from the tree.
Its sweetness...

A sky full of stars.
The northern lights dancing above the world.

The warmth of another human being.
The gentle touch of another hand.

The colors...
The life...
The world we once called home.
None of it is here anymore...
